capabilities: Translate a full document, a selection, or paragraph-by-paragraph bilingual
Proofread spelling and grammar with a diff review step
Mask wikilinks, tags, LaTeX, callouts and code blocks into placeholders before LLM calls
Clean video clipping transcripts and strip subtitle timestamps
Queue multiple tasks and keep per-device provider profiles
disambiguation: Not a general chat assistant; it only proofreads and translates Markdown notes.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian v1.7.2 or higher. Step-by-step manuals live in the /docs folder and GitHub Wiki rather than the README, and parts of the interface and release notes are in Korean.
problem: Sending notes to an LLM for translation or proofreading can break wikilinks, tags, LaTeX, callouts and code blocks, and Obsidian has no built-in way to run these tasks on a note.

relations.evidence: Built exclusively for FreeLLMAPI (34+ free providers, 635 endpoints, ~7.4B tokens/month)

summary: AI proofreading and translation assistant for Markdown notes that masks Obsidian syntax before sending text to an LLM.
